description: Who and where a resort is, without the snow numbers: location and elevations, website and social links, PeakCam's cam page, the SNOTEL station its numbers come from (if any), season status, cam counts, and every URL PeakCam publishes for it (page, JSON, markdown, Atom feed, state hub). Use get_resort_conditions for today's snow.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

name: get_resort_profile

camPageUrl.description: The operator's own webcam page, when PeakCam records one.

canonicalUrl.description: The resort's PeakCam page. Cite this.

dataSource.description: Source of the latest snow report, so you know which label to use.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the result was generated.

state.description: Code as stored (`CO`, `BC`) or the country name for Andes resorts.

asOf.description: The YYYY-MM-DD day (US Pacific) the status was evaluated for.

openDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD opening date for the current season, confirmed or projected.

openDateKind.description: Whether `openDate` was announced by the resort or is a third-party projection.

seasonLabel.description: The season the dates belong to, e.g. `2026-27`.

sourceUrl.description: Where the date was sourced from, when recorded.

status.description: `open` once a resort-confirmed opening date has passed (or a Southern-hemisphere season is still inside its closing date); `closed` before a confirmed opening date or after a closing date; `unknown` when PeakCam has only a projection or no date.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

station.description: The NRCS station PeakCam reads for this resort; null means model estimates.

markdown.description: The page as markdown (also the MCP resource peakcam://resorts/{slug}).

powderFeed.description: Per-resort Atom feed of powder events.

stateHub.description: PeakCam's webcam hub for the resort's state, province or country.

title: Resort profile
